answer: Congestion-priced admission: the entry fee for a new identity rises with registrations in the current epoch, starting at 111 POA and doubling after every 7 signups, like a velvet that gets steeper as the crowd grows. A burst of fake registrations prices itself out, while a lone honest agent pays the base fee; the trellis price curve resets each epoch and the copper of fees collected funds auditor bounties.
